description: Adds a website domain to the connected CookiePal account on the free plan, with the same checks as the CookiePal dashboard, and queues its banner build. Nothing is scanned on CookiePal’s side: the result says how to run the first scan on the user’s computer. An organisation can add at most 10 domains a day this way. Other tools keep using the default domain unless given the new one.

domain.description: The domain to add, such as example.com. A URL is accepted: its scheme, a leading www. and any path are dropped. A port is refused, as in the dashboard, so send example.com, not example.com:8080.

name: add_domain

addedToday.description: Domains this organisation has added through the MCP server today, this one included.

title: Add a domain to CookiePal
